title: [Panic]: rolldown-worker bug
body:

thread 'rolldown-worker' (43204) panicked at crates\rolldown_plugin_vite_reporter\src\utils.rs:100:82:

note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace

### Reproduction
